source.citation: Peng et al. 2024, Discovery of Oral Degraders of the ROS1 Fusion Protein with Potent Activity against Secondary Resistance Mutations. Journal of Medicinal Chemistry
source.table: Table 6: Activity of 9o against an expanded set of clinical ROS1 mutations in comparison with TKIs (IC50, nM)
source.assay: Ba/F3 cell proliferation; SLC34A2-ROS1 and CD74-ROS1 fusion backgrounds

note: Two fusion backgrounds (SLC34A2-ROS1 and CD74-ROS1), same kinase domain; each variant is scaled by the wild-type row of its own background. Variant names carry an @background suffix so that the same substitution on two backgrounds stays two profiles; both share one residue site. Site = position of the last-listed mutation. Source label 'F2075 V' read as F2075V. 9o is a proteolysis-targeting degrader, its anti-proliferative IC50 is used as that inhibitor's response and its mode is recorded as 'degrader'. Censored cells (>2000) are lower bounds (+1).
